description: A coalition of EU member states with strong public AI infrastructure projects begins withholding financial contributions to the Union's AI resilience fund, demanding a renegotiation of burden-sharing. The strike emerges from frustration over centralized decision-making and perceived inequities in resource allocation, threatening to paralyze ongoing recovery efforts.

In response to the accelerating pace of uncontrolled capability growth and repeated safety failures, a consortium of non-aligned states and civil society organizations announces the formation of an independent Global AI Watchdog. This body aims to monitor frontier developments, publish risk assessments, and coordinate early warnings, operating outside the influence of any single power bloc.
